comments.author: Caddy
comments.body: Anybody found anywhere decent to sell these? Only getting like 20-25k/unit in the few ports I had time to check earlier. Checked Palmas, Arguin, and Cabo Verde so far, but perhaps I hadn't gone far enough South.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: Only good place to sell these is in the West Africa area from Arguin to Cape Town. Bad prices elsewhere. However, they are good for indirect nanban trade for China and Korea, especially if their ports are in Plague status.
